persistence.shape: An array of up to eight lanes with stable id, version:1, target, unit, interpolation, points and optional bypass
persistence.ownership: Sound patch lanes are reusable in presets. Instrument lanes override matching Sound targets. A note automation descriptor captures the complete lane set plus source step/limitStep when unpacking a Beat passage. Vocal lanes belong to Clip effects.
persistence.current_only: Current readers validate the lane array. No old single-lane project reader or saved-file migration was added.
persistence.external_assets: Automation references parameters only. Recording bytes stay in external Assets.

targets.authority: src/dsp/parameters.js; automationParametersFor derives modulation targets and declared automation indices from the same bounds and units
targets.contexts: Synths expose oscillator/noise targets; samples and vocals expose applicable processing targets. Added filter instances expose independent cutoff/resonance. Width affects stereo content; it does not manufacture side information from a mono source.
targets.inactive_processors: Removing an instance from routing retains its settings and lanes for restoration. Unrouted instance lanes compile to no events. Bypass and zero mix retain their normal processing semantics.

points.position: Distinct stable point IDs and strictly increasing integer sixteenth-note steps inside the source range
points.outside_range: Hold the first/last value. Clip source-end boundaries hold through release tails.
points.step_timing: A step applies on the first sample at or after its boundary, with the same 1e-9-frame rounding tolerance used for native onsets.
points.bounds: Units, source support and value bounds come from the canonical parameter authority.

clock.unit: 60 / actual transport BPM / 4 seconds per step
clock.beat: Lanes span the Beat clock; Chunk boundaries do not reset them. Each referenced Beat repetition begins its own source clock.
clock.freeform: Captured lanes retain their source step and limitStep when a passage moves horizontally.
clock.vocal: Vocal source elapsedSteps and Clip duration bound the curve.
clock.native_streaming: JS page rebasing and C++ page/cycle activation shift every parameter event. Seek/loop reconstruction retains held voices, filter history and delay returns.
clock.live_edits: Use the existing prepared native revision replacement. Gesture recording and explicit manual override/rejoin modes remain unfinished.

rendering.browser: AudioParam lanes plus control signals retain pitch expression and modulation clamp precedence; dynamic stereo imaging uses the same mid/side equations.
rendering.native: Eight fixed lanes with 36 events each and monotonic cursors. Preparation and parsing stay on control. Per-sample evaluation and page/loop shifts allocate no callback memory.
rendering.wire: Current sample execution packet v19 appends a validated parameter-automation trailer; synth plans use the same trailer.
rendering.offline: The same plans drive playback and native/browser WAV rendering.

interface.entry: One shared automation panel in the Sound Inspector and selected Freeform note editor
interface.editing: Parameter selection, independent lanes, bypass/remove, linear/exponential/step curves, numeric points and interactive two-axis illustrations use the project undo path.

remaining: Additional effect/source/articulation targets and discrete parameter changes
Gesture recording and explicit live override/rejoin
Physical Windows and observed listening/newcomer qualification
